// userDataDir: Dedicated Edge profile for this tool. Sign in to Edge ITSELF here, once, by hand.
// targetMinutes: The daily goal shown on the Rewards card (usually 30).
// sessionTimeoutMinutes: Hard stop, even if the counter never reaches the target.
// remoteDebuggingPort: Port used to drive the real Edge over CDP.
// keepForeground: Periodically pull the Edge window to the foreground and block sleep. Edge only counts active browsing time, so this matters - but it steals focus, so run it while you are away.
// closeOnFinish: Close Edge when the target is reached (or the timeout hits).
// pollSeconds: How often to re-read the Rewards minute counter.
// dwell: How long to stay on one page before moving on, in seconds.
// bingSearchRatio: Share of page visits that are Bing searches; the rest come from browseUrls.
